text:
20 puzzles to test your eyes, memory and brain with Professor Hoot!
Can you get all 20 right? Easy at the start, harder at the end.

Puzzles in this video:
1. Spot the Difference
2. Memory Grid
3. What's Missing?
4. Mirror Giraffe
5. OTP Flash
6. Move the Bug (Listen!)
7. Which Row Is Different?
8. How Many Differences?
9. Odd Letter Out
10. Card Flip Memory
11. Add the Dice
12. Zoom Out
13. Which One Didn't Appear?
14. Spotlight
15. Pixel Guess
16. Find It in the Crowd
17. Colour Count
18. Number Twice
19. Fruit Math
20. Grid Finder

Comment your score out of 20 below!
Subscribe for new puzzles every day: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCl870UQHJt9aZCNW-IhK1gA?sub_confirmation=1

ANSWERS (no peeking!)
1. Spot the Difference: The trumpet became a horn.
2. Memory Grid: Number twelve flashed last.
3. What's Missing?: A, the bicycle! It pedalled away. (9 vehicles!)
4. Mirror Giraffe: Row four, column eight! The giraffe looking the other way.
5. OTP Flash: A, 729164!
6. Listen to Hoot, Move the Bug: Square ten! Up, up, left, left, down.
7. Which Row Is Different?: Row C! The hot dog and taco swapped.
8. How Many Differences?: B, two! The tree and the bird.
9. Odd Letter Out: The R!
10. Card Flip Memory: B, cards four and eleven!
11. Dice Flash: B, eleven! Six plus five.
12. Zoom Out: A, an octopus! Eight wiggly arms.
13. Which One Didn't Appear?: B, the kiwi never appeared.
14. Spotlight: A, a crocodile! Snap snap!
15. Pixel Guess: B, a guitar! Rock on!
16. Find It in the Crowd: Row five, column ten! There's the kitty.
17. Colour Count: B, six red shapes!
18. Number Twice: Thirty-six! It appears twice.
19. Fruit Math: B, six! Each banana is three.
20. Grid Finder: A, E two! Column E, row two.
